name: Review
summary: The review of the selected pull or merge request as one document: verdict, summary, points on exact lines, evidence and replies. You send it.
guidance: Review is on this canvas: a person reviews a pull or merge request here, as one document, and you can help by drafting. `read_focus` says which change is open and where somebody is pointing. `read_change`, then `read_diff`: it prints an old and a new line number beside every line, and those are what you cite. `add_comment` drafts a point on a line (give `commit` only for a line of one commit’s own diff), `add_evidence` keeps a screenshot, log or test output beside it, `set_verdict` proposes a summary and verdict. What the person wrote or kept is theirs: you cannot change it. Everything you write is a DRAFT; only the person sends, from the page. Do not post review comments with `gh` or `glab` yourself when a person is reviewing here.

mcp.about: Draft a review of a pull or merge request: points on exact lines, evidence, a summary, a verdict, replies. A Markdown file in the project; nothing here posts to a tracker.

partless: Shows the review of the one change a person selected, which is always in hand.

skills.name: review-pass
skills.summary: Type /review-pass on a pull or merge request: one careful review into Review — anchored, sourced, short points, the checklist answered, the path to approval.

skills.name: review-point
skills.summary: Type /review-point where you are pointing in the code: one well-sourced point at that line, in Review for you to keep, edit or drop.

skills.name: review-reply
skills.summary: Type /review-reply on your own pull or merge request: a reply to each review thread you received, and what to change. You post them.
